meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: Claude 能调用 cobrapy 库处理代谢模型：加载或导出 SBML/JSON 等格式模型，进行 FBA/FVA 通量分析，模拟基因敲除、设计培养基、采样通量等，并返回数值结果或 Python 脚本。
howto.when: 当用户要求加载或构建代谢模型、做通量分析（FBA/FVA 等）、或模拟基因敲除/设计培养基时触发。

say.text: 用 textbook 模型做一次 FBA，报告生长速率。
对 iJO1366 做单基因敲除筛选，列出必需基因。
say.note: 给出基因名单和生长值。

say.text: 为模型计算厌氧条件下的最小培养基。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the cobrapy library to handle metabolic models: load or export SBML/JSON models, run FBA/FVA flux analyses, simulate gene knockouts, design media, sample fluxes, and return numeric results or Python scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to load or build a metabolic model, run flux analyses like FBA/FVA, or simulate gene knockouts or design media.

say_en.text: Run an FBA on the textbook model and report the growth rate.
Perform a single-gene deletion screen on iJO1366 and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Provides gene list with growth values.

say_en.text: Compute a minimal medium for the model under anaerobic conditions.
